name: What is the process for getting a wheelchair accessible modification done on my home?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a wheelchair accessible modification done on my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation where a general contractor assesses your home and discusses your specific accessibility needs. Following this, a detailed design and proposal are created, outlining the scope of work, materials, and estimated costs. Once approved, necessary permits are secured. Construction then commences, followed by final inspections to ensure all modifications meet accessibility standards and client satisfaction. Regular communication is maintained throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, proposal, permitting, construction, and final inspection to ensure accessibility and satisfaction.
